subject: Post-call MAP draft & stakeholder decision rights (Acme Health)
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-03-21T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call MAP draft & stakeholder decision rights (Acme Health)

Hi Claire — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next actions from our discovery: 

- Goal: Replace the current on-prem low-latency inference stack for clinical alerts; target production pilot by mid-May.
- Key constraints: data residency in US-only region, SOC 2 evidence required, procurement needs PO and standard T&Cs.

I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Acme-MAP-v0.2.xlsx) with proposed milestones and owners. High-level milestones:

1) Security & compliance sign-off (deliver SOC2 extract + subprocessors) — owner: Acme security, support: Redwood compliance
2) Pilot deployment (2 nodes, regional VPC) — owner: Acme Eng Lead, support: Redwood Eng
3) Contract & PO finalization — owner: Acme procurement / Redwood sales
4) Production roll (SLA + monitoring) — owner: Joint

Dependencies called out in the workbook include: network peering window, KMS integration timeline, and procurement lead time (estimated 3 weeks).

Ask: can you confirm the internal stakeholders we should list as economic buyer, security owner, legal owner, and eng lead? Also please confirm a target close date (we suggested 2027-05-10).

I can iterate the MAP and circulate a version with a proposed RACI table once you confirm the names.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Claire Park <cpark@acmehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>, Jinsoo Park <jinsoo.park@acmehealth.com>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-21T17:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call MAP draft & stakeholder decision rights (Acme Health)

Diego — appreciate the clear recap. A few notes from our side and initial role assignments: 

Economic buyer: Markus Lee (CIO) — will sign final PO
Security owner: Jinsoo Park, Platform Security (copied)
Legal/Procurement owner: Sarah Nguyen (procurement@acmehealth.com) / procurement team
Eng lead: Luis Romero, Platform Engineering

We need the SOC2 extract and a short list of subprocessors to share with our compliance review team. Can Redwood provide a redacted SOC2 summary and confirm data flows (no PHI will be sent to Redwood in pilot)? 

Procurement is looped in for timeline awareness — they typically require the redline review + PO which is ~2–3 weeks once we get signed terms. Target close of early May is reasonable but contingent on compliance sign-off.

—Claire
Claire Park
Senior Director, Digital Platforms
Acme Health

- Security & compliance review: R = Jinsoo Park (Acme), A = Markus Lee (CIO), C = Redwood compliance, I = Procurement
- Pilot deployment (infra + network): R = Luis Romero (Acme Eng), A = Markus Lee, C = Redwood Eng, I = Procurement
- Contract negotiation & PO: R = Sarah Nguyen (Procurement), A = Markus Lee, C = Redwood Legal, I = Redwood Sales
- Production SLA sign-off: R = Luis Romero, A = Markus Lee, C = Redwood SRE, I = Support

Updated milestone dates in the workbook:
- Security sign-off: 2027-04-15
- Pilot deployment start: 2027-04-25
- Contract & PO complete: 2027-05-06
- Production roll / close: 2027-05-12 (flexible)

Dependencies noted: KMS key provisioning (Acme IT), network peering (timeline: 5 business days once request approved), procurement sign-off (see above).

Next steps from Redwood:
1) I'll share the MAP workbook with the RACI column filled and track changes for your edits.
2) Redwood compliance will provide a brief SOC2 caveats sheet and subprocessors list by EOD tomorrow.
3) Marissa (cc) will take point on contract coordination and will reach out to Sarah to schedule a redline sync.

If the role assignments above look right, we'll incorporate them into the MAP and move to version v0.3.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
